links.comparator_used: Alternative calibrated baselines (calibrating only one dimension, or marginal decompositions that are valid but conservative)
links.outcome: Number of sentences surfaced for review while meeting the target risk bound
links.effect: Surfaces up to 5x fewer sentences than alternative calibrated baselines. Satisfies the target risk bound at α = 0.15 with 95% confidence across 100 calibration/test resplits on five medical summarization tasks. Calibrating only one dimension can violate the target risk bound.
links.tradeoff: Needs about 100 labeled documents per domain for calibration. Review effort and residual risk must be traded off through tuning.
links.quote: By jointly calibrating over the full $(τ,γ)$ threshold space, CARE preserves formal guarantees while surfacing up to 5$\times$ fewer sentences than alternative calibrated baselines.

design_hint: calibrated omission and hallucination flagging for clinician review
